description: Extract only visible product packaging label information. Do not infer missing values. Preserve printed wording and units.

ProductName.description: Product name / statement of identity printed on the label.

Manufacturer.description: Manufacturer name and address, if visible.

Distributor.description: Distributor or packer name and address, if visible.

LotBatchNumber.description: Lot or batch number, preserving all characters.

ExpirationDate.description: Expiration, use-by or best-before date exactly as printed. Do not guess an ambiguous date.

ProductSize.description: Product size, count or dimensions printed on the label.

WeightVolume.description: Net weight or volume with all printed units.

PackagingInformation.description: Visible packaging descriptions or packaging information printed on the label.

RegulatoryStatements.description: All visible regulatory statements, certifications and disclosures, verbatim.

WarningLabels.description: All visible warnings and caution statements, verbatim.

QrCodes.description: Decoded QR code contents only if actually readable. If a QR code is visible but cannot be decoded, report 'QR code present; contents unreadable'. Never invent a URL.

OtherLabelInformation.description: All other visible label text, including ingredients, nutrition, business addresses, instructions and identifiers not already captured.
